questions.q: ₹450 is divided between A and B in the ratio 2 : 3. B's share is:
Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5 and their sum is 96. The smaller number is:
questions.e: The sum has 3 + 5 = 8 parts, each equal to 96 ÷ 8 = 12. The smaller number is 3 × 12 = 36.

questions.q: If 4 : 9 :: 16 : x, then x equals:
questions.e: In a proportion, 4 × x = 9 × 16, so x = 144 ÷ 4 = 36.

questions.q: The mean proportional between 4 and 25 is:
questions.e: The mean proportional of a and b is √(ab) = √100 = 10.

questions.q: 12 pens cost ₹90. What is the cost of 20 pens at the same rate?
questions.e: One pen costs 90 ÷ 12 = ₹7.50, so 20 pens cost 20 × 7.50 = ₹150.

questions.q: A father is three times as old as his son. The sum of their ages is 48 years. The son's age is:
questions.e: Ages are in the ratio 3 : 1 with 4 parts totalling 48, so one part is 12. The son is 12 years old.

questions.q: A and B invest ₹3000 and ₹5000 in a business for the same period. Out of a profit of ₹4000, A's share is:
questions.e: Profit is shared in the ratio 3 : 5. A's share = 3/8 × 4000 = ₹1500.

questions.q: 8 men can finish a job in 12 days. In how many days can 6 men finish it?
questions.e: Total work = 8 × 12 = 96 man-days. With 6 men it takes 96 ÷ 6 = 16 days.

questions.q: If A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5, then A : C is:
A mixture of 40 L has milk and water in the ratio 3 : 1. If 10 L of water is added, the new ratio of milk to water is:
questions.e: Milk = 30 L and water = 10 L. After adding 10 L water, water = 20 L, so milk : water = 30 : 20 = 3 : 2.

questions.q: The present ages of two persons are in the ratio 3 : 5. After 10 years the ratio will be 2 : 3. The sum of their present ages is:
questions.e: Let the ages be 3k and 5k. Then 3(3k + 10) = 2(5k + 10) gives k = 10, so the ages are 30 and 50 and their sum is 80.

questions.q: A invests ₹5000 for 12 months and B invests ₹6000 for 8 months. Of a total profit of ₹9000, A's share is:
questions.e: Profit is shared in the ratio of capital × time: 60000 : 48000 = 5 : 4. A's share = 5/9 × 9000 = ₹5000.

questions.q: Rice at ₹40 per kg is mixed with rice at ₹50 per kg to get a mixture worth ₹46 per kg. The ratio of the cheaper to the dearer rice is:
questions.e: By alligation, cheaper : dearer = (50 − 46) : (46 − 40) = 4 : 6 = 2 : 3.

questions.q: The incomes of two persons are in the ratio 5 : 4 and their expenditures in the ratio 3 : 2. If each saves ₹1600, the income of the first is:
questions.e: Let incomes be 5a and 4a, expenditures 3b and 2b. 5a − 3b = 1600 and 4a − 2b = 1600. Solving gives a = 800, so the first income is 5a = ₹4000.

questions.q: The salaries of A, B and C are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. They get increments of 15%, 10% and 20% respectively. The new ratio of their salaries is:
15 men working 8 hours a day can build a wall in 20 days. In how many days can 10 men working 6 hours a day build it?
questions.e: Work = 15 × 8 × 20 = 2400 man-hours. Per day, 10 men × 6 hours = 60 man-hours, so days = 2400 ÷ 60 = 40.

questions.q: A vessel holds 40 L of pure milk. 4 L is drawn out and replaced by water, and the same is done once more. The ratio of milk to water in the final mixture is:
questions.e: Each step keeps 9/10 of the milk, so milk = 40 × (9/10)² = 32.4 L and water = 7.6 L. The ratio is 32.4 : 7.6 = 324 : 76 = 81 : 19.

questions.q: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 5 : 7. Four years ago the sum of their ages was 40 years. B's age six years from now will be:
questions.e: Let the ages be 5k and 7k. Four years ago, (5k − 4) + (7k − 4) = 40 gives 12k = 48, so k = 4. B is 28 now and 34 after six years.

questions.q: A starts a business with ₹40,000. B joins after 4 months with ₹60,000 and C joins after 8 months with ₹90,000. At the end of the year the profit is ₹11,000. C's share is:
questions.e: Capital × months: A = 40000 × 12, B = 60000 × 8, C = 90000 × 4, which are in the ratio 4 : 4 : 3. C's share = 3/11 × 11000 = ₹3000.

questions.q: A bag holds ₹1, 50-paise and 25-paise coins in the ratio 3 : 4 : 6. The total value is ₹195. The number of 25-paise coins is:
questions.e: With 3k, 4k, 6k coins the value is 3k + 2k + 1.5k = 6.5k rupees. 6.5k = 195 gives k = 30, so 25-paise coins = 6k = 180.
